questions.question: The third proportional to 75 and 45 is the same as the fourth proportional to 10, 5x and 6x. Find the value of x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Third proportional** of 75 and 45 = (45 × 45) ÷ 75 = 27

**Fourth proportional** of 10, 5x, and 6x = (5x × 6x) ÷ 10 = 3x²

Equating both: 3x² = 27 ⇒ x² = 9 ⇒ x = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First set of numbers: 75, 45 (to find **Third Proportional**)

Second set of numbers: 10, 5x, 6x (to find **Fourth Proportional**)

**Formula Used:**

1. Third proportional (c) of a and b is given by: a/b = b/c ⇒ c = b²/a

2. Fourth proportional (d) of a, b, and c is given by: a/b = c/d ⇒ d = (b × c)/a

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81cc0e3a9ea26c749ece8ae5bf63aa66ba02045bd32e8e0a0748a9b483110cd8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the third proportional to 75 and 45 be 'c'.

⇒ c = (45 × 45) ÷ 75

⇒ c = 2025 ÷ 75 = 27

⇒ Let the fourth proportional to 10, 5x, and 6x be 'd'.

⇒ 10 / 5x = 6x / d

⇒ d = (5x × 6x) ÷ 10

⇒ d = 30x² ÷ 10 = 3x²

⇒ As per the question: c = d

⇒ 27 = 3x²

⇒ x² = 9

⇒ x = √9 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers **a** and **b** is √(a × b).

Continued Proportion

Three numbers **a**, **b**, **c** are said to be in **continued proportion** if a : b = b : c.

Compounded Ratio

For two ratios **a : b** and **c : d**, the compounded ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).

questions.question: A cube is melted and recast into a cuboid whose dimensions are in the ratio 4:5:8. If the height of the cuboid is 12 cm, then the edge of the original cube is (correct to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **cuboid** dimensions = 4 : 5 : 8.

Given **height** (8 units) = 12 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 1.5 cm.

Volume of **cuboid** = (4 × 1.5) × (5 × 1.5) × (8 × 1.5) = 6 × 7.5 × 12 = 540 cm³.

Since **Volume of Cube** = **Volume of Cuboid** ⇒ a³ = 540.

**Edge** a = ³√540 ≈ 8.14 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.14 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of dimensions = 4 : 5 : 8, Height = 12 cm.

**Formula:** **Volume** of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height; **Volume** of cube = (Edge)³.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/719970ec5a836374b973b7ba2c5238090952451e824f4937ae24be42f70e611a.png] 

⇒ Let the **dimensions** of the cuboid be 4x, 5x, and 8x.

⇒ Given **Height** = 8x = 12 cm.

⇒ x = 12 ÷ 8 = 1.5 cm.

⇒ Length = 4 × 1.5 = 6 cm and Breadth = 5 × 1.5 = 7.5 cm.

⇒ **Volume of Cuboid** = 6 × 7.5 × 12 = 540 cm³.

⇒ When a **cube** is melted to form a **cuboid**, their **volumes** remain equal.

⇒ **Volume of Cube** = 540 cm³.

⇒ (Edge)³ = 540.

⇒ Edge = 540¹/³.

⇒ Since 8³ = 512 and 9³ = 729, the value is slightly more than 8.

⇒ 8.14 × 8.14 × 8.14 ≈ 539.35 ≈ 540.

⇒ Edge ≈ 8.14 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.14 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area of Cube

Volume = a³ and Total Surface Area = 6a², where 'a' is the edge of the cube.

Volume of Cuboid

Volume = Length × Breadth × Height. Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl).

Recasting Rule

When one 3D shape is melted and recast into another, the **total volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage.

Diagonal Length

Diagonal of a cube = a√3 and diagonal of a cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²).

questions.question: A dealer buys an article marked at 1800 after successive discounts of 25% and 6(2)/(3)%. Find the cost price of the article to the dealer.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentage discounts to fractions: 25% = 1/4 and 6(2/3)% = 1/15.

Multipliers for discounts: (1 − 1/4) = 3/4 and (1 − 1/15) = 14/15.

Effective Multiplier = 3/4 × 14/15 = 7/10.

Cost Price = 1800 × 7/10 = 180 × 7 = 1260.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1260.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** = ₹1800

First **Discount** = 25%

Second **Discount** = 6(2/3)% = 20/3%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = MP × (100 − d₁)% × (100 − d₂)%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27fd773cddb0a4bb2798af56768f899c83cee277ae8165ef2f54263fcf88b24a.png] 

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 1800 − (25% of 1800)

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 1800 − 450 = ₹1350

⇒ Price after 2ⁿd discount = 1350 − (20/3% of 1350)

⇒ 2ⁿd discount amount = (20/300) × 1350 = 1/15 × 1350 = ₹90

⇒ Final **Cost Price (CP)** to the dealer = 1350 − 90 = ₹1260

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1260.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is given by (a + b − (a × b)/100)%.

Marked Price and Selling Price

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 − Discount%)/100. Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price.

Fractional Conversions

Using fractions like 6(2/3)% = 1/15 or 33(1/3)% = 1/3 can significantly speed up calculations in competitive exams.

questions.question: In a division sum, the divisor is 2 times the quotient and 3 times the remainder. If the remainder is 10, what is the dividend?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Remainder** = 10

**Divisor** = 3 × 10 = 30

**Quotient** = 30 ÷ 2 = 15

**Dividend** = (30 × 15) + 10 = 460

**∴ The correct answer is 460.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Remainder** = 10

**Divisor** = 2 × **Quotient**

**Divisor** = 3 × **Remainder**

**Formula Used:**

**Dividend** = (**Divisor** × **Quotient**) + **Remainder**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f7c22dbec87cdff07e66382523489e32ec2aa0b95d6ce316794c024e03073b.png] 

⇒ **Divisor** = 3 × 10 = 30

⇒ 30 = 2 × **Quotient** ⇒ **Quotient** = 30 ÷ 2 = 15

⇒ **Dividend** = (30 × 15) + 10

⇒ **Dividend** = 450 + 10 = 460

**∴ The correct answer is 460.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

The fundamental relation in arithmetic is Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder.

Remainder Rule

The **remainder** must always be a non-negative integer and strictly less than the **divisor** (0 ≤ Remainder < Divisor).

Perfect Divisibility

If a number is perfectly divisible by another, the **remainder** is always zero, meaning Dividend = Divisor × Quotient.

questions.question: From a regular octagon of side 4 units, a largest rectangle is cut out. From the remaining pieces, two largest rectangles are cut out. The remaining area of the octagon is _____ square units.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A **regular octagon** of side 4 units can be decomposed into a **central square** of area 4² = 16, **4 rectangles** of area 4 × 2√2, and **4 corner triangles**.

The **largest rectangle** (central strip) consists of the **central square** and **two rectangles**.

From the remaining **2 rectangles** and **4 triangles**, the **two largest rectangles** cut out are simply the two rectangles themselves.

The remaining area consists of the **4 corner right-angled triangles**.

Area of 4 corner triangles = 2 × (side)² ÷ 2 = (side)² = 4² = 16 square units.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 square units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the regular octagon (a) = 4 units

**Formula Used:**

Area of regular octagon = 2 × (1 + √2) × a²

Corner triangle leg (x) = a / √2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08d7b07f35d90fbb69b3d4dd2ff4e964190e0b028821e63365b1663cd6630be3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of Octagon = 2 × (1 + √2) × 4² = 32(1 + √2) = 32 + 32√2

⇒ Corner triangle leg (x) = 4 / √2 = 2√2

⇒ Largest Rectangle (R₁) = a × (a + 2x) = 4 × (4 + 4√2) = 16 + 16√2

⇒ Remaining Area after 1st cut = (32 + 32√2) − (16 + 16√2) = 16 + 16√2

⇒ This remaining area consists of two trapezoidal caps. Each cap area = 8 + 8√2

⇒ Largest rectangle from each cap (R₂) = a × x = 4 × 2√2 = 8√2

⇒ Total area of two rectangles cut from pieces = 2 × 8√2 = 16√2

⇒ Final remaining area = (16 + 16√2) − 16√2 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16 square units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Regular Octagon Properties

Each internal angle is 135°, and the total area can be seen as the area of a bounding square (a + 2x)² minus four corner triangles of area x²/2 each.

Largest Inscribed Rectangle

The largest rectangle inscribed in a regular octagon has an area exactly equal to half the area of the octagon, given by Area = a²(1 + √2).

Pythagoras in Octagons

The corner triangles formed when an octagon is inscribed in a square are isosceles right-angled triangles where the hypotenuse is the side of the octagon (a) and legs are x = a/√2.

questions.question: A sum of money earns ₹2,400 as simple interest in 2 years at 12% per annum. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **effective rate** for **Simple Interest** is calculated as **Rate × Time**.

Effective interest percentage = 12% × 2 = 24%.

Given that 24% of the **Sum** is equivalent to ₹2,400.

**Sum (Principal)** = (2400 ÷ 24) × 100 = 100 × 100 = ₹10,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = ₹2,400

**Rate (R)** = 12% per annum

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a235171ef0ee172f4cb9d6fa5595d1e914cc9eb2f73a8835e8998ada3fd4f208.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2400 = (P × 12 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 2400 = (P × 24) ÷ 100

⇒ 2400 × 100 = 24P

⇒ 240,000 = 24P

⇒ P = 240,000 ÷ 24

⇒ P = 10,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Amount in Simple Interest

The total sum of money after a period is called the **Amount (A)**, which is the sum of the **Principal (P)** and **Simple Interest (SI)**: A = P + SI.

Principal Formula

To find the **Principal** when SI, Rate, and Time are known: P = (100 × SI) ÷ (R × T).

SI vs CI for 1st Year

For the first year, if the interest is calculated annually, the **Simple Interest** and **Compound Interest** on a specific sum at the same rate are always equal.

questions.question: A milkman adds two litres of water to every eight litres of milk and sells it at 50% more than his cost price of milk. Find the profit percentage of the milkman.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Milk** to **Water** = 8 : 2 = 4 : 1. Total Quantity = 5 units.

Total CP = Quantity of Milk × CP = 4 × 1 = 4 units.

Total SP = Total Quantity × (CP + 50% increase) = 5 × 1.5 = 7.5 units.

Profit = 7.5 − 4 = 3.5 units.

Profit % = (3.5 ÷ 4) × 100 = 87.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 87.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Milk quantity = 8 litres | Water added = 2 litres | SP = 50% more than CP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f3f1cfa6b50bfa390561326b49955e4e471c6a00208477961f2f1901cdaa0c7.png] 

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 litre of milk = ₹100.

⇒ Total CP of 8 litres of milk = 8 × 100 = ₹800.

⇒ Total quantity of the mixture = 8 + 2 = 10 litres.

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** per litre = 100 + 50% of 100 = ₹150.

⇒ Total Selling Price (SP) = 10 × 150 = ₹1500.

⇒ **Profit** = Total SP − Total CP = 1500 − 800 = ₹700.

⇒ **Profit Percentage** = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (700 ÷ 800) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 87.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 87.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

Profit % = [ (True Value − Error) ÷ Error ] × 100 is used when the weight is manipulated, but for mixture problems, use total CP and total SP.

Successive Change Formula

Total change % = a + b + (ab ÷ 100), where 'a' is the percentage increase due to quantity (water addition) and 'b' is the price markup percentage.

Effective Profit from Adulteration

If a milkman adds water and sells at CP, profit % = (Water ÷ Milk) × 100. If he also marks up the price, the net profit is calculated on the initial cost of milk only.

questions.question: If a recipe requires ingredients in the ratio 1:2 and you have 3 cups of the first ingredient, how many cups of the second ingredient should you use?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the **ratio** 1 : 2, for every 1 part of the **first ingredient**, there are 2 parts of the **second ingredient**.

If 1 unit = 3 cups,

Then 2 units = 2 × 3 = 6 cups.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cups.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Let the quantity of the **second ingredient** be x cups.

⇒ Ratio = (Ingredient 1) ÷ (Ingredient 2)

⇒ 1 ÷ 2 = 3 ÷ x

⇒ 1 × x = 3 × 2

⇒ x = 6 cups

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks the price of a washing machine 40% above its cost price. He offers a 25% discount on the marked price to attract customers. If the final selling price of the washing machine is ₹21,000, what was its cost price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit% = Mark-up% − Discount% − (Mark-up × Discount)/100

Net Profit% = 40 − 25 − (40 × 25)/100 = 15 − 10 = 5%

Selling Price = 105% of Cost Price ⇒ 21,000 = 1.05 × CP

CP = 21,000 ÷ 1.05 = 20,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mark-up Percentage = 40%

Discount Percentage = 25%

**Selling Price (SP)** = ₹21,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ee2c9f74f9365d7f5b71f40b184cbe7aa32fe90ca057d978b321b0650c29471.png] 

⇒ Let **Cost Price (CP)** = 100 units

⇒ **Marked Price (MP)** = 100 + 40% of 100 = 140 units

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 140 − 25% of 140

⇒ SP = 140 − (25 ÷ 100) × 140 = 140 − 35 = 105 units

⇒ Given, 105 units = ₹21,000

⇒ 1 unit = 21,000 ÷ 105 = 200

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** = 100 units = 100 × 200 = ₹20,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mark-up Percentage

The percentage by which the cost price is increased to set the marked price. Formula: Mark-up% = (MP − CP)/CP × 100.

Relationship between CP and MP

CP × (100 + Profit%) = MP × (100 − Discount%). This ratio can be used to directly find the relation between CP and MP.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value is increased by x% and then decreased by y%, the net change is [x − y − (xy/100)]%.

questions.question:
Simplify:

 frac{sin A cos (90circ - A)}{cot (90circ + A) cos (180circ + A)}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **quadrant rules**: **cos(90° − A) = sin A**, **cot(90° + A) = −tan A**, and **cos(180° + A) = −cos A**.

Numerator = sin A × sin A = sin² A.

Denominator = (−tan A) × (−cos A) = tan A × cos A = (sin A / cos A) × cos A = sin A.

Expression = sin² A / sin A = sin A.

**∴ The correct answer is sin A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** [sin A × cos(90° − A)] / [cot(90° + A) × cos(180° + A)]

**Trigonometric Transformations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b35db47b87a9d8c8d666c1ce171ce7915791f060aa1e4ce3340dda0003f16f80.png] 

**Step-by-step Simplification:**

⇒ **Numerator:** sin A × cos(90° − A)

⇒ In 1st quadrant, cos(90° − A) = **sin A**

⇒ Numerator = sin A × sin A = **sin² A**

⇒ **Denominator:** cot(90° + A) × cos(180° + A)

⇒ In 2nd quadrant, cot(90° + A) = **−tan A**

⇒ In 3rd quadrant, cos(180° + A) = **−cos A**

⇒ Denominator = (−tan A) × (−cos A) = **tan A × cos A**

⇒ Denominator = (sin A / cos A) × cos A = **sin A**

⇒ **Final Expression:** sin² A / sin A

⇒ Expression = **sin A**

**∴ The correct answer is sin A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

ASTC Rule

It determines the sign of **trigonometric ratios**: 1st Quadrant (All positive), 2nd (Sine/Cosec positive), 3rd (Tan/Cot positive), and 4th (Cos/Sec positive).

Complementary Ratio Changes

Ratios change to their **co-ratios** at (90° ± θ) or (270° ± θ): sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot, and sec ↔ cosec.

Tangent Identity

tan A = sin A / cos A and cot A = cos A / sin A. These are fundamental for simplifying product-form **trigonometric expressions**.

questions.question: A shop sold 5 types of items over a week: 120, 150, 110, 130, and 140 units respectively. After receiving a return of 10 units from the first item, what is the new arithmetic mean (in units) of items sold?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total units initially sold = 120 + 150 + 110 + 130 + 140 = 650 units

Initial **Arithmetic Mean** = 650 ÷ 5 = 130 units

A **return** of 10 units reduces the total sum by 10.

Reduction in mean = Total Reduction ÷ Number of items = 10 ÷ 5 = 2 units

New **Arithmetic Mean** = 130 − 2 = 128 units

**∴ The correct answer is 128 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Units sold for 5 items = 120, 150, 110, 130, 140

Return from the **first item** = 10 units

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00aec364de3939e3a62e5348ba9b3a7c4d9bac8b9e2c01775c77c11b7123ae09.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **New value** of the first item = 120 − 10 = 110 units

⇒ **Sum of new observations** = 110 + 150 + 110 + 130 + 140

⇒ **Total Sum** = 640 units

⇒ **New Arithmetic Mean** = 640 ÷ 5

⇒ **New Mean** = 128 units

**∴ The correct answer is 128 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean (Average)

The average of a set of numbers is the sum of the numbers divided by the count. Formula: x̄ = (Σxᵢ) ÷ n.

Property of Change in Mean

If every observation in a data set is decreased by a constant value **k**, then the mean of the new observations is decreased by **k**. If only one observation is decreased by **k**, the mean decreases by **k/n**.

Sum of Deviations

The sum of the deviations of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always equal to zero, i.e., Σ(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

questions.question: In a division sum, the divisor is 9 times the quotient and 3 times the remainder. If the remainder is 42, what is the dividend?

**Remainder** = 42

**Divisor** = 3 × 42 = 126

**Quotient** = 126 ÷ 9 = 14

**Dividend** = (126 × 14) + 42 = 1764 + 42 = 1806

**∴ The correct answer is 1806.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The **remainder** is 42. The **divisor** is 9 times the **quotient** and 3 times the **remainder**.

**Formula Used:** **Dividend** = (**Divisor** × **Quotient**) + **Remainder**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3929d68056b93b2fcdaca0ca5852ea3cca0c0bab79a825250347a0b895d0008.png] 

⇒ **Remainder** = 42

⇒ **Divisor** = 3 × 42 = 126

⇒ **Quotient** = 126 ÷ 9 = 14

⇒ **Dividend** = (126 × 14) + 42

⇒ **Dividend** = 1764 + 42 = 1806

**∴ The correct answer is 1806.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

For any two integers a and b (b ≠ 0), there exist unique integers q and r such that a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < |b|.

Remainder Rule

The **remainder** must always be non-negative and strictly smaller than the **divisor**.

Verification of Division

To verify a division result, compute (**Divisor** × **Quotient**) + **Remainder**; the sum must equal the **dividend**.

questions.question: During a sale, 50% of the goods are sold at 37% profit, 30% of the remaining goods are sold at 26% profit and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 24%. If there is an overall profit of x%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **quantities** sold: 50 : (30% of 50) : (50 − 15) ⇒ 50 : 15 : 35 ⇒ **10 : 3 : 7**.

Net Profit x% = [(10 × 37) + (3 × 26) − (7 × 24)] ÷ (10 + 3 + 7)

x% = [370 + 78 − 168] ÷ 20 ⇒ 280 ÷ 20 = 14%.

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 50% goods at 37% **profit**, 30% of remaining at 26% **profit**, rest at 24% **loss**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99a928a7b87ee7fc2b5bf5e940be21a6a8f143d54118a7adae0f026ab06bb28a.png] 

Assume total quantity = 100 units and **Cost Price (CP)** of each unit = ₹1.

⇒ Total **Cost Price** = ₹100.

⇒ Case 1: 50 units sold at 37% profit ⇒ **Profit₁** = 50 × 37/100 = ₹18.5.

⇒ Remaining units = 100 − 50 = 50 units.

⇒ Case 2: 30% of 50 = 15 units sold at 26% profit ⇒ **Profit₂** = 15 × 26/100 = ₹3.9.

⇒ Case 3: Remaining units = 50 − 15 = 35 units sold at 24% loss ⇒ **Loss₃** = 35 × 24/100 = ₹8.4.

⇒ Total **Net Profit** = Profit₁ + Profit₂ − Loss₃

⇒ Total **Net Profit** = 18.5 + 3.9 − 8.4 = ₹14.

⇒ Overall Profit Percentage (x) = (Total Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

⇒ x = (14 ÷ 100) × 100 = 14%.

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

Net Profit/Loss% = (n₁p₁ + n₂p₂ + ... + nₖpₖ) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ... + nₖ), where n is quantity and p is profit(+)/loss(−) percentage.

Net Profit Percentage

Overall Profit % = [(Total Selling Price − Total Cost Price) ÷ Total Cost Price] × 100.

Successive Percentage

If a value is changed by a% and then by b%, the net change is [a + b + (a × b)/100] %.

questions.question: A sum of money at compound interest, compounded annually grows to ₹24000 in 2 years and ₹28800 in 3 years. Find the annual rate of interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For consecutive years in **Compound Interest**, the **Amount** of the previous year acts as the **Principal** for the subsequent year.

**Interest** for the 3rd year = ₹28,800 − ₹24,000 = ₹4,800.

**Rate of Interest** (R) = (Interest ÷ Principal for the year) × 100

R = (4,800 ÷ 24,000) × 100 = 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount after 2 years (A₂) = **₹24,000**

Amount after 3 years (A₃) = **₹28,800**

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a49b83fd1f492384a9b3c7a344b3b9cd4628b4cabec6edbf68ee950767c989f4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A₂ = P(1 + R/100)² = 24000

⇒ A₃ = P(1 + R/100)³ = 28800

⇒ A₃ ÷ A₂ = [P(1 + R/100)³] ÷ [P(1 + R/100)²]

⇒ 28800 ÷ 24000 = (1 + R/100)

⇒ 288 ÷ 240 = 1 + R/100

⇒ 1.2 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R/100 = 1.2 − 1 = 0.2

⇒ R = 0.2 × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Interest Rate

If interest is compounded **n** times a year, the effective annual rate is given by Rₑff = [1 + (R ÷ n)]ⁿ − 1.

Difference between SI and CI

For a period of 2 years, the difference between **Simple Interest** and **Compound Interest** is D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: The monthly incomes (in ₹ thousands) of ten employees are 35, 40, 38, 50, 46, 42, 39, 37, 41, and 44. What is the median income of the employees (in ₹ thousands)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the **monthly incomes** in **ascending order**: 35, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42, 44, 46, 50.

Count of observations (n) = 10 (which is **even**).

Median = Average of the **middle two terms** (5th and 6th terms).

Median = (40 + 41) ÷ 2 = 40.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Monthly incomes of 10 employees (in ₹ thousands) are 35, 40, 38, 50, 46, 42, 39, 37, 41, and 44.

**Formula Used:**

For an **even number of observations (n)**:

Median = [(n/2)th observation + (n/2 + 1)th observation] ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0caae40fd0493cd6df79e48d687c1d016595dc457034fd37e348bff8cfb9c363.png] 

⇒ Total observations (n) = 10

⇒ Arrange incomes in **ascending order**: 35, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42, 44, 46, 50

⇒ n/2 = 10/2 = 5th term

⇒ n/2 + 1 = 10/2 + 1 = 6th term

⇒ 5th term = 40 and 6th term = 41

⇒ Median = (40 + 41) ÷ 2

⇒ Median = 81 ÷ 2 = 40.5

**∴ The correct answer is 40.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd Number of Terms

If n is odd, the **Median** is simply the middle-most value, calculated as the ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term after sorting.

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions: **Mode** = 3 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**.

Effect of Outliers

The **Median** is a measure of central tendency that is robust against **outliers**, unlike the arithmetic mean which is heavily influenced by extreme values.

Ratio of **Surface Area** = R² : (n × r²) = (R/r)² : n.

Required Ratio = 3² : 27 = 9 : 27 = 1 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 1:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Radius of the **larger metallic sphere** (R) = 6 units, Total number of **smaller spheres** (n) = 27.

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³; Surface area of sphere = 4πr².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f8a30fe81bcc80b04966cda6758026bd804776a6ca21ebd96ffe1f73922e8b.png] 

⇒ Total **Volume** remains constant: Volume of Large Sphere = 27 × Volume of Small Sphere

⇒ (4/3)π × 6³ = 27 × (4/3)π × r³

⇒ 216 = 27 × r³

⇒ r³ = 216 / 27 = 8

⇒ r = √³8 = 2 units

⇒ Surface Area of **Large Sphere** (SAL) = 4π × R² = 4π × 6² = 144π

⇒ Total Surface Area of **27 Small Spheres** (SAS_ₜₒₜₐₗ) = 27 × (4π × r²)

⇒ SAS_ₜₒₜₐₗ = 27 × 4π × 2² = 27 × 16π = 432π

⇒ Required Ratio = SAL : SAS_ₜₒₜₐₗ = 144π : 432π

⇒ Ratio = 144 / 432 = 1 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 1:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

In melting and recasting problems, the **initial volume** of the object always equals the **final total volume** of all new objects formed.

If the radius of a sphere is scaled by a factor k, its **surface area** scales by k² and its **volume** scales by k³.

For a sphere cut in half, the curved surface area is 2πr² and the **total surface area** is 3πr².

questions.question: Which type of unemployment is caused by a decline in aggregate demand during economic downturns?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclical**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclical unemployment** refers to the component of overall unemployment that results directly from cycles of **economic upturn** and **downturn**.
 
• It occurs when there is a significant decline in **aggregate demand** (the total demand for goods and services in an economy) during a **recession** or **depression**.
 
• When consumer spending falls, businesses experience reduced revenues and are forced to scale back **production**, leading to **layoffs** and a reduction in the workforce to manage costs.
 
• This type of unemployment is typically **involuntary** and is highly sensitive to the **macroeconomic** health of a country; it increases when **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** declines and decreases during periods of **economic expansion**.
 
• Economists use the **Okuns Law** to describe the relationship between **cyclical unemployment** and the gap between actual and potential **GDP** growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Structural Unemployment**:

 
 
• Arises due to a fundamental **mismatch** between the skills workers possess and the skills required for available jobs.
 
• Often caused by **technological shifts** (automation), **globalization**, or changes in **consumer preferences** that render certain industries obsolete.
 
 
 
• **Voluntary Unemployment**:
 
 
• Occurs when an individual chooses not to work at the prevailing **market wage rate**.
 
• Reasons may include searching for a better job (**frictional**), pursuing education, or personal lifestyle choices.
 
 
 
• **Seasonal Unemployment**:
 
 
• Occurs when the demand for labor changes systematically according to the time of year.
 
• Commonly observed in sectors like **agriculture** (harvesting periods), **tourism** (holiday seasons), and **retail** (festival rushes).

questions.question: Article 22 provides safeguards to arrested or detained individuals under which two detention categories?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Punitive and preventive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 22** of the **Indian Constitution** provides fundamental protections to individuals against **arbitrary arrest** and **detention**.
 
• The Constitution classifies detention into two broad categories: **Punitive detention** and **Preventive detention**.
 
• **Punitive detention** refers to the detention of a person after a **formal trial** and **conviction** in a court of law for an offense already committed by them.
 
• **Preventive detention** is the detention of a person without any trial or conviction, based solely on the apprehension that the person may commit an act that is prejudicial to the **security of the state** or **public order**.
 
• The objective of **preventive detention** is not to punish an individual for a past offense but to prevent them from committing an offense in the near future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Safeguards for Punitive Detention (Article 22(1) and (2))**:

 
 
• The right to be informed of the **grounds of arrest** as soon as possible.
 
• The right to consult and be defended by a **legal practitioner** of one's choice.
 
• The right to be produced before the nearest **Magistrate** within a period of **24 hours** (excluding travel time).
 
• No person can be detained in custody beyond **24 hours** without the authority of a **Magistrate**.
 
 
 
• **Safeguards for Preventive Detention (Article 22(4) to (7))**:
 
 
• A person cannot be detained for more than **three months** unless an **Advisory Board**, comprising persons qualified to be **High Court Judges**, finds sufficient cause for an extension.
 
• The **detaining authority** must communicate the grounds of detention to the detenu, though facts deemed against the **public interest** can be withheld.
 
• The individual must be given the earliest opportunity to make a **representation** against the detention order.
 
• Both **Parliament** and **State Legislatures** have the power to enact laws for preventive detention under the **Seventh Schedule**.

questions.question: When fats react with sodium hydroxide to produce soap and glycerol, the reaction is classified as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Saponification reaction**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saponification** is the chemical process involving the **alkaline hydrolysis** of **esters**, specifically the **triglycerides** found in **fats** and **oils**.
 
• When **sodium hydroxide** (NaOH) reacts with these **fats**, it breaks the **ester bonds** through a nucleophilic attack by the **hydroxide ion**.
 
• The reaction results in the production of **glycerol** (a trihydric alcohol) and **sodium salts of long-chain fatty acids**, which are the primary constituents of **soap**.
 
• The general chemical equation for this transformation is: Triglyceride + 3NaOH rightarrow Glycerol + 3Soap .
 
• This reaction is **exothermic** in nature and is the fundamental process used in the industrial **manufacturing of soap**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Precipitation reaction**

 
 
• Characterized by the formation of an **insoluble solid** (precipitate) when two **aqueous solutions** containing soluble salts are mixed.
 
• Commonly used in **qualitative inorganic analysis** to identify **cations** and **anions**.
 
 
 
• **Combustion reaction**
 
 
• An **oxidation** process where a substance reacts rapidly with **oxygen**, releasing energy in the form of **heat** and **light**.
 
• Typical products include **carbon dioxide** (CO₂) and **water** (H₂O) when **hydrocarbons** are burned.
 
 
 
• **Fermentation reaction**
 
 
• An **anaerobic** metabolic process that converts **sugars** into **ethanol**, **lactic acid**, or **gases**.
 
• It is mediated by **enzymes** or **microorganisms** like **yeast** and **bacteria**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 42** of the **Indian Constitution** explicitly mandates that the State shall make provisions for securing **just and humane conditions of work** and for **maternity relief**.
 
• This article is categorized under the **Socialistic Principles** of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**, which aim to establish a **welfare state** and ensure social and economic justice for all citizens.
 
• The provision for **maternity relief** in this article serves as the constitutional foundation for various welfare legislations, most notably the **Maternity Benefit Act, 1961**, and its subsequent amendments, which provide paid leave and medical benefits to pregnant women.
 
• Under **Part IV** of the Constitution (covering **Articles 36 to 51**), these principles are considered **fundamental in the governance** of the country, although they are **non-justiciable**, meaning they cannot be directly enforced by any court.
 
• The phrase **just and humane conditions** requires the State to ensure that the working environment is safe, healthy, and respects the basic **human dignity** of the laborers, preventing exploitation and hazardous employment practices.

• States that it is the duty of the State to raise the **level of nutrition** and the **standard of living** of its people and to improve **public health**, including the prohibition of intoxicating drinks and drugs.

• The primary journey connected **Paris**, **France**, to **Istanbul**, **Turkey**, traversing approximately **3,000 kilometers** almost entirely through **European** sovereign territories.

questions.question: Which of the following executive powers is exercised by the President of India?

options.text: Deciding the tenure of the Governors
Appointing the Prime Minister and, on his advice, other Union Ministers
Appointing judges of High Courts and framing the rules of procedure of the Supreme Court

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Appointing the Prime Minister and, on his advice, other Union Ministers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 75** of the **Constitution of India**, the **Prime Minister** is appointed by the **President**, and other **Union Ministers** are appointed by the President based on the **recommendation** and **advice** of the Prime Minister.
 
• The **executive power** of the Union is formally vested in the **President** under **Article 53**, which states that these powers shall be exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him.
 
• As the formal head of the **Union Executive**, the President ensures the formation of the government by inviting the leader of the majority party or coalition in the **Lok Sabha** to serve as the **Prime Minister**.
 
• All **executive actions** of the **Government of India** are formally taken in the name of the President, as specified under **Article 77** of the Constitution.
 
• While the President is the **nominal executive** (de jure head), he acts on the **aid and advice** of the **Council of Ministers** headed by the Prime Minister, making the latter the **real executive** (de facto head).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conducting Elections**:

 
 
• The responsibility for the **superintendence, direction, and control** of elections to the **Parliament** and **State Legislatures** is vested in the **Election Commission of India** under **Article 324**, not the President.
 
 
 
• **Tenure of Governors**:
 
 
• Under **Article 156**, the **Governor** of a State holds office during the **pleasure of the President**. While the President can remove them at any time, the normal term is **five years**, and this power is exercised on the advice of the **Union Cabinet**.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Procedures**:
 
 
• While the President appoints judges of the **Supreme Court** and **High Courts** under **Article 124** and **Article 217**, the power to **frame rules of procedure** for the Supreme Court lies with the **Supreme Court** itself under **Article 145**, subject to the **approval** of the President.
 
 
 
• **Other Executive Appointments**:
 
 
• The President also appoints the **Attorney General of India**, the **Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG)**, the **Chief Election Commissioner**, and the **Chairman and members** of the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**.

__
 
• **Vasco da Gama**, a **Portuguese** explorer, was the first European to reach **India** via the **Atlantic Ocean**, completing the longest sea voyage of the time.
 
• He set sail from **Lisbon** on **8 July 1497** with a fleet of four ships, including the flagship **Sao Gabriel**.
 
• After rounding the **Cape of Good Hope** in **South Africa**, the fleet sailed across the **Indian Ocean** with the help of a local navigator.
 
• The expedition successfully reached **Kappad**, a beach situated about 16 kilometers from the city of **Calicut** (modern-day **Kozhikode**) in **Kerala**, on **20 May 1498**.
 
• His arrival marked the beginning of a direct **sea route** between **Europe** and **Asia**, effectively bypassing the **Silk Road** and the **Ottoman Empire**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zamorin of Calicut**:

 
 
• Upon arrival, **Vasco da Gama** was received by the local ruler, the **Zamorin** (Samoothiri).
 
• Although the **Zamorin** welcomed him, initial trade negotiations were difficult because the gifts provided by the **Portuguese** were considered insufficient by local standards.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Trade**:
 
 
• The discovery of this route led to the **Portuguese** dominance of the **Spice Trade** for nearly a century.
 
• It paved the way for future European colonization in **Asia**, particularly by the **Dutch**, **French**, and **British**.
 
 
 
• **Later Life**:
 
 
• **Vasco da Gama** returned to **India** twice more in **1502** and **1524**.
 
• He was appointed as the **Viceroy of India** in **1524** but died shortly after in **Cochin** due to malaria.

questions.question: Which of the following is the specialized kind of cell division that reduces the chromosome number by half, resulting in the production of haploid daughter cells?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Meiosis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meiosis** is a specialized type of **cell division** that reduces the **chromosome number** by half, specifically occurring in the **germ cells** of sexually reproducing organisms.
 
• It results in the transformation of a **diploid cell** (containing two sets of chromosomes, **2n**) into four **haploid daughter cells** (containing a single set of chromosomes, **n**), which are known as **gametes** (sperm and egg).
 
• The process involves two successive rounds of nuclear and cytoplasmic division, termed **Meiosis I** and **Meiosis II**, but includes only one cycle of **DNA replication** during the **S-phase** of interphase.
 
• In **Meiosis I**, homologous chromosomes pair up and exchange genetic material through a process called **crossing over** or **recombination** during **Prophase I**, which ensures **genetic diversity** in the offspring.
 
• **Meiosis II** is similar to mitosis, where **sister chromatids** are separated, eventually producing four genetically unique **haploid cells** that are essential for maintaining a constant chromosome number across generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mitosis**:

 
 
• Commonly referred to as **equational division**, it occurs in **somatic cells** for growth, tissue repair, and asexual reproduction.
 
• Unlike meiosis, mitosis results in two **genetically identical** daughter cells with the same **diploid** chromosome number as the parent cell.
 
 
 
• **Fertilization**:
 
 
• This is the process of fusion of a **haploid male gamete** and a **haploid female gamete** to form a **diploid zygote**.
 
• It essentially acts as the biological counterpart to meiosis, restoring the **diploid** state (2n) necessary for the development of a new organism.
 
 
 
• **Translocation**:
 
 
• This is a type of **chromosomal abnormality** where a segment of one chromosome breaks off and attaches to a **non-homologous chromosome**.
 
• It is a structural **mutation** rather than a standard mode of cell division and can lead to genetic disorders or certain types of **cancer**.

questions.question: In pre-independence India, who among the following first discussed the concept of the poverty line in his book Poverty and Un-British Rule in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji**, widely known as the **Grand Old Man of India**, was the first person in pre-independence India to scientifically estimate the **poverty line** and discuss it in detail.
 
• In his seminal work titled **Poverty and Un-British Rule in India**, published in **1901**, he highlighted the extreme economic distress and exploitation of the Indian population under the colonial administration.
 
• He formulated the famous **Drain of Wealth** theory, asserting that Britain was systematically siphoning off India's resources, capital, and wealth, which led to widespread famine and poverty.
 
• To quantify poverty, Naoroji used the **jail cost of living** as a proxy for the minimum subsistence level, arguing that even the diet provided to prisoners should be considered the baseline for survival.
 
• His calculations for the period **1867-68** suggested a poverty line ranging from **Rs 16 to Rs 35** per capita per year, based on the prices of essential commodities like rice, flour, dal, ghee, and salt.
 
• He arrived at this figure by calculating the food requirements of an adult and adjusting it for the total population, including children, through a weighted average method.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Methodology of Estimation**:

 
 
• Naoroji divided the population into two categories: **producers** (adults) and **non-producers** (children).
 
• He assumed children constituted **one-third** of the population and consumed very little, while the remaining **two-thirds** were adults who consumed the full **jail diet**.
 
• By taking the average of these groups, he derived the **subsistence level** required for a person to remain above the poverty line.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context of Options**:
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**: Focused on the concept of **Gram Swaraj** and rural empowerment but did not formulate a statistical poverty line in a published book format like Naoroji.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**: Chaired the **National Planning Committee** in **1938**, which later worked on defining basic minimum standards of living, but this was decades after Naoroji's initial work.
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore**: While he contributed significantly to rural reconstruction through **Sriniketan**, his work was primarily social and philosophical rather than statistical economic analysis.
 
 
 
• **Political Legacy**:
 
 
• Naoroji was a co-founder of the **Indian National Congress** and served as its President in **1886**, **1893**, and **1906**.
 
• He was also the first Indian to be elected as a member of the **British House of Commons**, representing the **Liberal Party**.

• The **Lok Adalat** is not bound by the **Code of Civil Procedure, 1908** or the **Indian Evidence Act, 1872**, which allows it to bypass formal courtroom rigmarole and technical evidence rules. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
 
• The essence of a **People’s Court** lies in its **informal, flexible, and less technical** nature, which ensures that disputes are settled through a friendly dialogue and conciliation rather than adversarial litigation. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***

questions.question: The river Kosi frequently shifts its channel in the plains mainly because:

options.text: It traverses a long stretch of tectonic rifted lowland
It carries huge quantities of sediment from the Himalayas
Large upstream dams constantly modify their natural flow
Its flow is sustained only by seasonal monsoon rain

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It carries huge quantities of sediment from the Himalayas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kosi River**, an antecedent river originating in the high **Himalayas** (Tibet and Nepal), drains one of the most geologically unstable and erosion-prone mountain ranges in the world.
 
• Due to the steep mountain gradients and fragile lithology of its catchment area, the river carries an exceptionally high **sediment load** consisting of **silt**, **sand**, and **boulders**.
 
• When the river emerges from the foothills and enters the flat **Indo-Gangetic plains** of **North Bihar**, its flow **velocity** decreases drastically due to the sudden reduction in the slope.
 
• The reduced energy of the water makes it unable to transport the heavy debris, leading to massive **sedimentation** and the continuous rising of the riverbed, a process known as **aggradation**.
 
• As the riverbed becomes choked with silt, the river is forced to breach its natural levees and seek a new path with a lower elevation, resulting in frequent **lateral channel shifts** or **avulsions**.
 
• Historically, the Kosi has shifted its course westward by approximately **120 kilometers** over the last **250 years**, creating a massive **alluvial fan** known as the **Kosi Mega-fan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sorrow of Bihar**:

 
 
• The river is notorious for catastrophic **flooding** and unpredictable behavior, earning it the title **Sorrow of Bihar** because of the massive displacement of people and destruction of crops.
 
• Its major tributaries include the **Sun Kosi**, **Arun**, and **Tamur**, which join at the **Triveni** in Nepal to form the **Saptakoshi**.
 
 
 
• **Tectonic and Climatic Factors**:
 
 
• Unlike the **Narmada** and **Tapi**, which flow through **tectonic rift valleys**, the Kosi flows over a deep **alluvial basin** where shifting is primarily a function of **siltation** rather than structural rifts.
 
• While the **Southwest Monsoon** provides nearly **80 percent** of the annual water discharge, the sediment dynamics remain the fundamental cause of the channel instability.
 
• The **Kosi Barrage** at **Birpur** was constructed to regulate flow and manage irrigation, but the high **siltation rates** continue to pose a major challenge to flood management infrastructure.

questions.question: In a row of 214 students facing north, Rt is 164th from the left end. If Kl is 37th to the right of Rt, what is Kl's position from the right end of the line?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Total number of students in the line = 214

Position of **Rt** from the left end = 164th

Position of **Kl** from the left end = Position of **Rt** from the left end + 37

= 164 + 37

= 201st

Position of **Kl** from the right end = (Total number of students + 1) − Position of **Kl** from the left end

= (214 + 1) − 201

= 215 − 201

= 14th

So, **Kl** is 14th from the right end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
